variants.headline: Still in view: home world answers colony's petition
variants.sub: A reply to the colony's petition has come from the home world.
variants.body:
Coverage continues after {months_running} months; this is a continuing story rather than a fresh announcement. The home world has answered the colony's petition.

The role of {target} should be considered without assuming the reply's terms. This paper records the answer as an established event and leaves unreported acceptance or refusal outside its factual account.
